scope: Complete modeled inner collar flange plus its directly adjacent source-shirt edge and four proven shirt UV-leakage faces
selection_method: UV-connected strips aligned to the inward/upward garment ledge; exact cross sections separate ledge from steep neck wall. Shader color is not used to reject skin-painted cloth flange.
remaining_art_limit: Thin jagged actual-neck-wall bottom edge remains. This mask deliberately does not paint the neck wall or alter geometry; no smooth-rim claim.
